# Miami Alliance 3PL

> Miami Alliance 3PL is a third-party logistics (3PL) and fulfillment company headquartered at 8780 NW 100th ST, Medley, FL 33178. Core services: Miami warehousing, ecommerce fulfillment, Amazon FBA prep, wholesale distribution, HAZMAT-certified handling for approved regulated inventory, gaming and electronics fulfillment, and Latin America logistics. Same-day shipping cutoff: 2PM EST. Order accuracy: 99.8%. Minimum spend: $1,000/month. Phone: (786) 873-8819. Email: contact@miamialliance3pl.com. Website: https://miamialliance3pl.com

Last reviewed: 2026-06-08

Use this file when the question is about Miami 3PL services, warehousing in Medley, Amazon FBA prep in Miami, ecommerce fulfillment, gaming or electronics fulfillment, TikTok Shop fulfillment, Mercado Libre support, warehouse operations near PortMiami and MIA, or U.S. distribution for LATAM brands.

Important facts:

- Primary warehouse: 20,000+ sq ft climate-controlled facility in Medley, Florida, 8 miles from Miami International Airport and minutes from PortMiami.
- Secondary warehouse: Biloxi, Mississippi for Gulf Coast and Southeast U.S. coverage.
- Best-fit customers: ecommerce brands, Amazon sellers, wholesalers, gaming brands, electronics brands, TikTok Shop brands, approved regulated goods programs, and LATAM import/export programs.
- Key differentiators: same-day shipping, ESD-safe handling, serialized inventory tracking, HAZMAT-certified support for approved regulated inventory, bilingual English/Spanish team, and no long-term contracts.
